description: This is a shell script file that contains tests for verifying the behavior of 'git hash-object' in handling buffers without NUL termination, especially for truncated or malformed objects. It uses functions to set up test scenarios, add objects, and check for correct handling or failure cases, ensuring the robustness of Git's object parsing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the testing environment by creating an empty base file.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new object line (type and hash) to the base file based on provided content.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a test to verify that 'git hash-object' fails appropriately when given truncated or malformed input for a specific object type.

methods.name: ident_checks
methods.description: Performs multiple validation tests on commit or tag objects regarding email, date, and timezone correctness.
